$comment: Collections Cloud Functions use that are NOT declared server-owned in security/collections.json, each with why and the client files that write it. Checked by security/check_server_collections.js: a collection functions use must be declared server-owned there or listed here, and an entry functions no longer use (or that the table now declares server-owned) fails as stale, so this list only shrinks. Seeded 2026-11-05 (rules plan T13). Entries marked BLOCKED are server-owned in the target design (plan §4.4/§4.5) but still have client writers; declare them once the named task moves those writers onto callables.

ai_pipeline_runs.reason: Clients start and delete runs through ScopedCollection; functions update run progress.

announcements.reason: Authored by members in the Announcements app; functions only fan out notifications.

app_requests.reason: App Maker requests are created and edited by their requesters; functions link them to dev changes.

apps.reason: Platform catalog with its own match block: platform admins and developers write it from App Creator. Permission fields move to a callable in T28.

bets.reason: Created and settled by members in the Bets app.

billing_disputes.reason: Dispute threads are opened and updated by the billed user and the billing team from the client.

bug_reports.reason: Improve Apps tickets are filed and edited by users; functions update status and links.

calendar_calendars.reason: Calendar: people create, rename, share and delete their own calendars (restrictEditToCreator); calendarLeaveCalendar takes a member off one, and Sell bookings read a booking calendar's members.

calendar_events.reason: Calendar events are user-authored (CalendarService); functions maintain the materialized watermark (adminOnly in the table).

calendar_private_events.reason: Calendar: a calendar's members create and edit its events; onCalendarPrivateEventWritten and onCalendarCalendarWritten keep ownerIds equal to the calendar's members, the reminder sweep writes materializedThrough, and Sell bookings add events.

calendar_user_settings.reason: Personal settings with their own match block (owner read/write).

ce_profiles.reason: Continuing Education profiles are edited by their members.

checkers_games.reason: Game state is written by players (immutableDoc in the table covers finished games).

civ_empire_games.reason: Players create a game once from the lobby; immutableDoc in the table blocks every later client write, and the civEmpirePlay callable makes all changes after that (its turns subcollection is serverWritten).

flock_games.reason: Players create a game once from the lobby; immutableDoc in the table blocks every later client write, and the flockPlay callable makes all changes after that.

collection_catalog.reason: Not client-written: its own match block denies every client write (`allow write: if false`) and functions/collection_catalog.js is the only writer. Listed here because ownMatchBlock entries don't count as server-owned for this check.

contacts.reason: Members add and edit contacts in the Contacts app; functions/client_portal.js only sets the serverField linkedUids (client portal accounts).

conversations.reason: Chat conversations: participants update lastMessage; chatStartConversation and chatAddMembers (functions/chat.js) create conversations and change their membership (blockCreate, membership fields adminOnly in the table).

convo_starter_history.reason: Functions append the sent question; the client favourites, deletes and adds entries.

convo_starter_settings.reason: Users edit their own schedule; functions advance nextNotifyAt.

crm_activities.reason: CRM: members log notes, calls, emails, meetings and stage changes on deals; crmOnInvoicingDocumentWritten adds quote events and crmDeleteDeal removes a deleted deal's log.

crm_deals.reason: CRM: members create and work deals; crmOnInvoicingDocumentWritten sets the quote fields (serverFields) and can mark a deal won, and crmDeleteDeal removes one.

crm_settings.reason: CRM: editors write the group's pipelines and settings; functions only read winOnQuoteAccepted.

domain_verifications.reason: The platform team's SES domain checklist (kind platform_admin): platform admins and developers tick steps off, delete checklists and open one for a new group's domain from the Groups admin console; updateGroupDetails retires and opens checklists when it changes an existing group's domain.

event_planner_events.reason: Events are organizer-authored; server-maintained fields are adminOnly in the table.

expense_entries.reason: Expenses: people write their own expenses' content; the expenses* callables and expensesOnEntryWritten write every status and decision field (serverFields), and invoicingIssue/invoicingVoid the invoice stamps.

expense_settings.reason: Expenses: editors write the group's categories and rules; functions only read them when an expense is submitted.

hr_checklist_templates.reason: HR: editors write checklist templates; hrStartChecklist only reads one to copy its tasks.

hr_people.reason: HR: editors write the staff directory; hrUpdateMyProfile edits a person's own phone, pronouns and about line, and the hr* callables and hrOnPersonWritten read it.

hr_settings.reason: HR: editors write the leave types, working week and holidays; functions only read them to count leave days.

inventory_items.reason: Inventory: editors write the item list; inventoryOnMovementCreated writes the stock levels (serverFields) as it applies movements.

inventory_locations.reason: Inventory: editors write the locations; inventoryOnMovementCreated only reads them to check a movement's location.

inventory_movements.reason: Inventory: members record stock movements; inventoryOnMovementCreated applies each one and writes its outcome (serverFields).

inventory_purchase_orders.reason: Inventory: editors write purchase orders; inventoryOnMovementCreated adds receipts to received (serverFields).

inventory_settings.reason: Inventory: editors write the group's settings and the app numbers purchase orders from its counter; inventoryOnMovementCreated only reads alertUserIds.

feature_requests.reason: Improve Apps feature requests are filed, voted on and edited by users.

files.reason: Storage app file records are created and deleted by their uploaders; functions only read them for usage counts.

form_assignments.reason: The sender creates assignments (FormsService.assignForm) and member assignees complete their own (completeAssignments); formsSaveAssignmentByToken completes a guest's token-bound assignment, which its non-member recipient can't write.

forms.reason: Forms are built, answered and published from the client (FormsService); formsSaveAssignmentByToken saves a guest recipient's answers and rolls the status up, since the guest isn't a member of the sender's group.

gallery_photos.reason: Gallery photos are uploaded and deleted by members.

improve_bluejay_subscriptions.reason: Users set their own Improve Apps notification subscriptions.

insurance_applications.reason: Applicants author applications; paid/bound state is staffOnly in the table and written by the payments core.

invoicing_documents.reason: Invoices: editors write a draft's content through ScopedCollection; the invoicing callables write every state change (status, number, payments: serverFields) and issue recurring copies.

invoicing_settings.reason: Invoices: editors write the group's invoicing settings; functions only read them when issuing.

naic_sight_jobs.reason: Jobs are created and deleted by the user; functions process them (the batches subcollection is server-written).

photo_albums.reason: Albums are created and edited by members.

platform_config.reason: Platform config with its own match block: platform admins and developers write it from the client (default apps, marketplace and pricing settings).

polls.reason: Polls are created and closed by their creators; functions/polls.js recounts each poll's results (voteCounts, voterCount, voterIds: serverFields in the table) from its ballots.

projects.reason: Task List lists are edited by their members (membership changes go through callables; creatorOnly in the table).

projects_hub_blockers.reason: Projects tasks/blockers are authored by members; functions link tickets to them.

qr_codes.reason: QR codes are created and deleted by members.

recipes.reason: Cookbook recipes are authored by members.

shop_sales_pages.reason: Sellers author direct sales pages in Sell; functions read them to serve the public page and price submissions.

shop_sales_submissions.reason: Created only by shopSalesSubmit (blockCreate) and paid only by the payments core (serverFields); the seller updates status, schedule and notes from Sell.

shop_notification_recipients.reason: Sellers choose who hears about their requests in Sell; functions read them to notify on a guest's paid order.

shop_product_requests.reason: Members create requests in Shop and sellers update them in Sell; functions create a guest's (shopStorefrontCheckout) and the payments core marks it paid (serverFields).

shop_products.reason: Sellers manage products in Sell; functions only read them to attribute legacy wood_shop/ Storage photos.

shop_sellers.reason: Each seller writes their own shop info and the Sell to guests switch (guestCheckout) in Sell; functions read them to build the guest storefront.

shop_shipping_sizes.reason: Sellers manage shipping sizes in Sell; functions read them to price a guest's checkout.

signature_audit_logs.reason: BLOCKED: the signing audit trail should be serverWritten (plan Appendix A), but SignaturesService still appends entries from the client (_logAudit). Move that append into the signing callables first.

signature_documents.reason: Documents are created and edited by their senders; signed-state fields become serverFields later (Appendix A).

signature_recipients.reason: Recipients are added by the sender; signed-state fields become serverFields later (Appendix A).

system_report_subscriptions.reason: Users subscribe and unsubscribe themselves; functions read them to send reports.

tap_war_games.reason: Game state is written by players.

time_entries.reason: Time Tracking: people log and edit their own time; invoicingIssue and invoicingVoid set and clear only the invoiceId/invoiceNumber/invoicedAt serverFields.

trivia_games.reason: Game state is written by the host and players (creatorOnly/protectedRoleField in the table).

usage_daily.reason: Each client increments its own daily usage counters, whatever app is open (memberWrite + idPattern + singleOwner/restrictEditToCreator in the table).

users.reason: Profiles with their own match block; owners write their profile fields from the client. Role/status fields become serverFields of the personal kind (plan §4.5, T6).

vendor_market_categories.reason: Operator staff manage categories in Marketplace Admin through ScopedCollection; vendorHubUpdateListing only reads them to check a vendor's chosen categories.

vendor_market_listing_private.reason: Operator staff edit contact details through ScopedCollection (identity fields adminOnly in the table); claimed vendors in other groups edit theirs through vendorHubUpdateListing (functions/vendor_hub.js).

vendor_market_listings.reason: Operator staff edit listings through ScopedCollection (claim fields adminOnly in the table); claimed vendors in other groups edit theirs through vendorHubUpdateListing (functions/vendor_hub.js); the claim flow writes the claim fields.

vendor_market_timeline.reason: The organizer edits their own timeline; vendorMarketShareTimeline snapshots it into vendor_market_timeline_shares (serverWritten).

dashboards.reason: The Dashboards app creates its own dashboards and edits title, spec and pinned directly (ownerScoped, singleOwner); functions write only the request and draft serverFields (dashboardsRequest, the queue mirror, the dashboard artifact's publish and approve).

warehouse_dashboards.reason: Data Warehouse editors create and edit dashboards (writeTier edit); functions only read them, to serve dashboards shared with corporate guests (functions/_warehouse_reader_access.js).

attendees.reason: calendar_events/{id}/attendees: inviters add/remove attendees and each attendee updates their own status (selfKeyed in the table).

comments.reason: Comment threads (bug_reports, feature_requests, app_requests, recipes, …) are authored by users.

versions.reason: dashboards/{id}/versions: the owner records each direct edit as an immutable version (authorField creatorId in the table); the dashboard artifact's publish writes the developer agent's drafts.

exceptions.reason: calendar_events/{id}/exceptions: recurring-event exceptions are written by CalendarService.

messages.reason: conversations/{id}/messages: each participant writes their own messages (authorField senderId); chatAddMembers writes the server-only system messages (senderId 'system').

notification_prefs.reason: projects_hub_projects/{id}/notification_prefs: each reader mutes or unmutes alerts for the project on their own uid-keyed doc (selfKeyed in the table); projectsOnTaskWritten only reads it.

photo_comments.reason: recipes/{id}/photo_comments: members comment on a recipe's gallery photos (authorField commenterId in the table); cookbookDeletePhoto/cookbookDeleteRecipe delete them with the photo or recipe.

photos.reason: photo_albums/{id}/photos and recipes/{id}/photos are uploaded by members.

votes.reason: Each member writes their own vote doc (selfKeyed in the table: polls, bug_reports, feature_requests); for tickets, functions/_vote_tally.js seeds vote docs from legacy vote arrays and recounts the tallies; functions/_poll_tally.js recounts a poll's results from its ballots.
